結構化摘要.結論: In adults with CKD, engaging in MVPA of ≥150 minutes per week was associated with significantly lower risks of mortality and CVDs. These findings underscore the value of physical activity promotion in CKD management.

結構化摘要.方法: We analyzed data from the Japan Environment and Children's Study, a nationwide prospective birth cohort. A total of 2,679 mother-child pairs were included. Multivariable logistic regression models were used to estimate the associations.
結構化摘要.結果: At 6 years of age, 262 children (9.8%) had decreased kidney function.
